title: How to Enhance Equipment with Star Force
original_title: How do I enhance equips with Star Force?
author: Nexon MapleStory Support
summary: The official Star Force workflow covering equipment eligibility, meso cost, Star Catching, Safeguard, success and failure outcomes, Chance Time, and Equipment Traces.

sections.title: Starting an attempt
items: Open Equipment Enchant and place eligible equipment in the window.
Review the next stat gain, success chance, and meso cost before confirming.

sections.title: Risk controls
items: Star Catching can improve the success chance.
Safeguard costs more mesos but removes destruction risk where available.

sections.title: Outcomes and recovery
items: Attempts can succeed, keep, drop, or destroy depending on the current star level.
Chance Time and Equipment Traces provide specific recovery paths after failures.

notes: Official support article verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
steps: Complete Star Catching and confirm the result.
Repeat only within the planned budget.
recommended_items: Eligible replacement equipment for trace recovery
